# Quikanva

Quikanva is a free, open-source, native macOS 14+ visual scratchpad for quick diagrams and sketches. A configurable global shortcut opens a focused canvas with shapes, arrows, lines, text, images, freehand drawing, selection, styling, snapping, autosave, Gallery management, and PNG/JPEG export.

Quikanva is local-first. It has no account, analytics SDK, advertising SDK, or network service. Sketches are stored under the user's Application Support directory. The current 0.2.x direct-download build is unsigned.
